title: Bitbond company history
notes: First-party company history states that Bitbond was founded in Berlin in 2013 and began as a regulated blockchain lending platform.

title: What is the Bitbond STO?
notes: First-party description of the BB1 security-token issuer, intended use of proceeds, coupon structure, and relationship to SME loans on the Bitbond lending platform. Token rights are not equated with ordinary marketplace lender claims.

title: Bitbond's State of the Union 2020
notes: First-party update says Bitbond shifted toward tokenized securities, returned its asset-broker licence, stopped further loan origination, and continued administering the existing SME loan portfolio.

title: Bitbond tokenization infrastructure
notes: Current official site presents Bitbond as institutional tokenization infrastructure. It supports classifying the historical lending marketplace as ended while keeping the current company outside that failure classification.
